class.name: BoneClothSimulator3D
class.brief_description: A [SkeletonModifier3D] that sways bone chains such as hair, skirts and capes.
class.description: This node sways hair, skirts, capes and tails, and returns them toward the animated pose. Each chain runs from its root bone down to its end bone. The root bone follows the pose and the bones below it sway. A chain can branch from a bone of an earlier chain; list the trunk before its branches. Chains whose bones sit at the same places, as in the stacked skirt chains of a VRoid model, move as one. The values apply to every chain. Use a separate node for parts that need other values. To tune a node, start from a preset in the [b]Presets[/b] submenu of the node's toolbar menu. Then set how far the chains swing with [member stiffness/value] and [member limit_angle/value], and how soon they settle with [member drag/value]. Add [BoneClothCollision3D] nodes as children to keep the chains out of the body. Lengths and speeds are in meters at the size of the character's model, so a centimeter rig takes the same values as a meter rig. While the project runs, the [b]Monitors[/b] tab of the [b]Debugger[/b] shows the cost under [b]Bone Cloth[/b]. [b]Note:[/b] Most methods in this class take an [code]index[/code] parameter. This parameter specifies which chain to use (e.g. [code]chains/<index>/root_bone_name[/code]), except in the sync bone methods, where it specifies which sync bone to use (e.g. [code]sync/bones/<index>/bone_name[/code]).

method.name: apply_preset
method.description: Copies the values of [param preset] to this node. The chains, [member link_mode], the backstop's bone and offset, and the collisions are not changed.

method.name: are_all_child_collisions_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if all child [BoneClothCollision3D]s collide with the chain, except those in its exclude collision list.

method.name: clear_collisions
method.description: Clears the chain's collision list. Works only while [method are_all_child_collisions_enabled] is [code]false[/code].

method.name: clear_exclude_collisions
method.description: Clears the chain's exclude collision list. Works only while [method are_all_child_collisions_enabled] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: get_collision_count
method.description: Returns the number of collisions in the chain's collision list.

method.name: get_collision_path
method.description: Returns the node path of the [BoneClothCollision3D] at [param collision] in the chain's collision list.

method.name: get_end_bone
method.description: Returns the end bone index of the chain.

method.name: get_end_bone_direction
method.description: Returns the tail direction of the chain's end bone.

method.name: get_end_bone_length
method.description: Returns the tail length of the chain's end bone.

method.name: get_end_bone_name
method.description: Returns the end bone name of the chain.

method.name: get_exclude_collision_count
method.description: Returns the number of collisions in the chain's exclude collision list.

method.name: get_exclude_collision_path
method.description: Returns the node path of the [BoneClothCollision3D] at [param collision] in the chain's exclude collision list.

method.name: get_root_bone
method.description: Returns the root bone index of the chain.

method.name: get_root_bone_name
method.description: Returns the root bone name of the chain.

method.name: get_sync_bone
method.description: Returns the bone index of the sync bone.

method.name: get_sync_bone_name
method.description: Returns the bone name of the sync bone.

method.name: is_end_bone_extended
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the chain's end bone is extended to have a tail.

method.name: make_preset
method.description: Returns a new [BoneClothPreset] with this node's values.

method.name: reset
method.description: Resets the chains to the current pose, at rest. Call it when the pose jumps, such as after [method AnimationPlayer.play] without blending.

method.name: set_collision_count
method.description: Sets the number of collisions in the chain's collision list. Works only while [method are_all_child_collisions_enabled] is [code]false[/code].

method.name: set_collision_path
method.description: Sets the node path of the [BoneClothCollision3D] at [param collision] in the chain's collision list. The node must be a child of this node. Works only while [method are_all_child_collisions_enabled] is [code]false[/code].

method.name: set_enable_all_child_collisions
method.description: If [param enabled] is [code]true[/code], all child [BoneClothCollision3D]s collide with the chain, except those in its exclude collision list ([method set_exclude_collision_path]). If [param enabled] is [code]false[/code], only the collisions in its collision list ([method set_collision_path]) collide with the chain.

method.name: set_end_bone
method.description: Sets the end bone index of the chain. [code]-1[/code] is no bone.

method.name: set_end_bone_direction
method.description: Sets the tail direction of the chain's end bone, in the end bone's own axes.

method.name: set_end_bone_length
method.description: Sets the tail length of the chain's end bone, in meters.

method.name: set_end_bone_name
method.description: Sets the end bone name of the chain. The end bone must be the root bone or below it.

method.name: set_exclude_collision_count
method.description: Sets the number of collisions in the chain's exclude collision list. Works only while [method are_all_child_collisions_enabled] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: set_exclude_collision_path
method.description: Sets the node path of the [BoneClothCollision3D] at [param collision] in the chain's exclude collision list. The node must be a child of this node. Works only while [method are_all_child_collisions_enabled] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: set_extend_end_bone
method.description: If [param enabled] is [code]true[/code], the chain's end bone gets a tail so that it can sway too. [b]Note:[/b] Unlike [SpringBoneSimulator3D], the end bone is extended by default, with a length of [code]0.1[/code].

method.name: set_root_bone
method.description: Sets the root bone index of the chain. [code]-1[/code] is no bone.

method.name: set_root_bone_name
method.description: Sets the root bone name of the chain. The root bone follows the pose, unless [member root_spring_stiffness] is above [code]0.0[/code].

method.name: set_sync_bone
method.description: Sets the bone index of the sync bone. [code]-1[/code] is no bone.

method.name: set_sync_bone_name
method.description: Sets the bone name of the sync bone, such as a thigh inside a skirt. See [member sync/bone_count]. An empty name is no bone.

members.member: The index of [member backstop/bone_name]. [code]-1[/code] is no bone.

The bone at the center of the backstop, such as the head for bangs. The backstop is a wall behind each joint's pose that keeps the joint from moving toward this center, so bangs stay out of the head without a collision. An empty name disables it. On a long chain in a violent move, joints far from the root can still pass the wall slightly, because each joint is placed after the one above it. To see the walls, check [b]Show Backstop[/b] in the node's toolbar menu.
Scales [member backstop/distance] from the roots ([code]0.0[/code]) to the tips ([code]1.0[/code]).
How far, in meters, each joint can move from its pose toward the center of the backstop. [code]0.0[/code] puts the wall at the pose.
The position offset of the backstop's center from [member backstop/bone_name], along the bone's axes. For bangs, put the center in the middle of the head.
The radius, in meters, of the wall behind each joint. The default [code]10.0[/code] is almost flat, and smaller values curve it. [code]0.0[/code] disables the backstop.
The number of chains.
How steady the part near the roots stays while the character moves, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. The tips still sway. Raise it to keep a skirt's waist steady while its hem swings.
Scales [member drag/value] from the roots ([code]0.0[/code]) to the tips ([code]1.0[/code]).

How soon the swaying dies out after the character stops, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. Recommended values are between [code]0.1[/code] and [code]0.3[/code]; higher values do not settle sooner.
Scales [member gravity/value] from the roots ([code]0.0[/code]) to the tips ([code]1.0[/code]).
The direction of gravity, in world space. It cannot be zero.
The gravity, in m/s^2. [code]9.8[/code] is the earth's gravity. [code]0.0[/code] disables it. [b]Note:[/b] Unlike [SpringBoneSimulator3D], this is an acceleration, not a velocity.
How much the cloth reacts to the character's movement and rotation, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. Lower it if the cloth reacts too much.
Softens the cloth's reaction to sudden starts and stops. [code]0.0[/code] disables it.

The maximum speed of each joint, in m/s. Keeps the tips of long chains from swinging out too far. Low values weaken the push out of collisions. [code]3.0[/code] suits long hair. [code]0.0[/code] disables it.
Scales [member limit_angle/value] from the roots ([code]0.0[/code]) to the tips ([code]1.0[/code]).

How firmly [member limit_angle/value] holds, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. Lower values let long hair slide over a shoulder instead of jumping through it. [code]0.66[/code] suits long hair.

The maximum angle each bone can swing from the pose, in radians. Recommended values are between [code]0.5[/code] (30 degrees) and [code]1.3[/code] (75 degrees). [code]0.0[/code] disables it. To see the limits, check [b]Show Limit Angle[/b] in the node's toolbar menu.
Links neighboring chains so that a collision cannot pass between them. A branch that starts below its trunk's root is not linked.
Scales [member link_spacing/value] from the roots ([code]0.0[/code]) to the tips ([code]1.0[/code]). For long hair, keep it at [code]0.0[/code] until past the middle.
How strongly linked chains keep apart, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. Keeps gaps between strands of long hair. [code]0.0[/code] disables it.
If [code]true[/code], linked chains part around a collision, as long hair parts over a shoulder. Leave it [code]false[/code] for skirts and capes.

How strongly the links hold neighboring chains together, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. Recommended values are between [code]0.0[/code] and [code]0.5[/code]. At [code]0.0[/code], the links only collide.

The speed of the roots, in m/s, above which the chains move with them instead of swaying. Keeps long hair from flapping with every stride of a run. [code]3.0[/code] suits long hair. [code]0.0[/code] disables it.
Like [member local_movement_speed_limit], for rotation, in radians per second. [code]6.283[/code] (360 degrees) suits long hair. [code]0.0[/code] disables it.
Scales [member max_distance/value] from the roots ([code]0.0[/code]) to the tips ([code]1.0[/code]).

How far, in meters, each joint can move from its pose. It keeps chains from flying off in fast moves, such as a dash or a sudden stop. [code]0.0[/code] disables it. To see the limits, check [b]Show Max Distance[/b] in the node's toolbar menu.
How firmly [member max_distance/value] and the backstop hold, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. Lower values let a joint pass the limit and come back over the next steps.
The character speed, in m/s, above which the cloth stops reacting to faster movement.
Scales [member radius/value] from the roots ([code]0.0[/code]) to the tips ([code]1.0[/code]).

If [code]true[/code], cloth that touches a collision in the rest pose stays as modeled, such as a skirt's waist against the thighs. Set it to [code]false[/code] for long hair that hangs through the shoulders in the rest pose.
The radius of each joint against the collisions, in meters.
How far the root bone can move forward along its bone, in meters. Keeps a breast from stretching forward when the character stops.
How far the root bone can move from the pose, in meters.
Lets the root bone sway too, for a part that moves as a lump, such as a breast. Lower values bounce longer. [code]0.0[/code] disables it.
The character rotation speed, in radians per second, above which the cloth stops reacting to faster turns.
Scales [member stiffness/value] from the roots ([code]0.0[/code]) to the tips ([code]1.0[/code]).

How strongly the chains return to the pose, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. Higher values swing less. Recommended values are between [code]0.05[/code] and [code]0.2[/code]. [b]Note:[/b] Values from [SpringBoneSimulator3D] do not carry over.

The number of sync bones. The chains turn from their roots as these bones swing, as a skirt follows the thighs so that the legs do not pass through it. Add both thighs for a skirt or a long coat. Each chain follows each sync bone by where it hangs around the body: fully on the bone's side, a quarter at a right angle to it, not at all on the opposite side. A bone turning around its own length does not turn the chains.

How far the chains turn with the sync bones ([member sync/bone_count]), from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. At [code]1.0[/code], a chain on a bone's side turns as far as the bone swings. [code]0.7[/code] suits a skirt.
A turn of the character larger than this in one frame, in radians, is a teleport, and the cloth ignores it.
A move of the character farther than this in one frame, in meters, is a teleport, and the cloth ignores it.
How fast this simulator's chains waver in the wind, multiplied by [member BoneClothWind3D.frequency].
Scales [code]wind_influence/value[/code] along the chain, from the root (0) to the tip (1). Lower the start of the curve to keep the waist of a skirt or the roots of bangs steady.
How much wind this simulator receives. [code]0.0[/code] ignores wind. The root of a chain never receives wind.
How closely neighboring chains move together in the wind. [code]1.0[/code] moves them as one, [code]0.0[/code] moves them separately.
How much this simulator's chains waver in the wind, multiplied by [member BoneClothWind3D.turbulence].

constants.constant: Each chain is linked to the next one in the list, for a cape or a skirt open at the front.
The chains are linked all around, in their order around the direction they hang, whatever their list order. For a skirt all around.
